decisions.reason: As a multi-model system building on an established offer, it likely carries enough development and launch investment that management would hesitate to withdraw it quickly despite limited later visibility.
This arena floor line appears to involve meaningful sunk costs and public commitment, so under escalation-of-commitment logic management is still somewhat more likely to persist than to exit.

Because it is another multi-model arena flooring line tied to the firm’s existing capabilities, management has reason to continue rather than admit a premature mistake unless weak results become unmistakable.
The chevron parquet was presented as a flagship and fits the firm’s announced trend-led interior direction, making withdrawal unlikely because it would openly reverse a visible strategic commitment.
As a narrower surface-finish add-on rather than a central product line, it likely involved less investment and less public commitment, so management can more easily discontinue it.
This skirting product is a small adjacent accessory with limited strategic visibility, so it is the easiest candidate to remove and reallocate resources away from.
